body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> The media convergence specialist corporate Enspert (representative Lee Chang-seok, www.enspert.com) participates to CES 2011 which is held in Las Vegas for 4 days from January 6 to 9.
Enspert will unveil high-tech device which will lead global tablet PC market by introducing E301, the next generation version of Identity Tab E201 model which had unveiled at last CES.

It has a strategy to make sure that Enspert is the leading corporate in tablet PC market with E301 by upgrading basic functionalities such as OS, resolution and touch and loading various new technologies.

Enspert will also exhibit tablet PC which supports a variety of worldwide mobile TV and DAB(Digital Audio Broadcasting) at CES 2011. In addition to, it will introduce Solp(Service over IP) technology, a evolved model of internet phone VolP.

Lee Sang-Su, a president of Enspert, said "In 2011, Enspert will target global market in earnest with CES as our starting point. We want to surpass the domestic market and arise the quality of our products and brand value as the Korea's first tablet PC corporate."
(Photo: Enspert had opened exhibition booth at YG Family's concert for consumers to experience Identity Tab)
